text: Why do customers buy once, and vanish?
Because you built a funnel. Ads. Visit. Buy. Then... nothing.
A flywheel puts them back in. Attract. Sell. Delight. Refer.
One. Message every buyer on day three.
Two. Ask the happy ones for a review.
Three. Give them a reason to bring a friend.
Stop refilling the funnel. Spin the wheel.
